# Aleph Skill v2.5.0-rc.1

## Reviewed causal drafts. Reproducible strategic scenarios.

Aleph 2.5 adds an evidence-to-model drafting workflow, an eligible direct
linear solver for instantaneous feedback components, and multi-round strategic
roleplay. This prerelease includes the integrity fixes from the upgrade review
and integrates the D Research 3.6 search and optional CDP browser improvements.

Stable 2.4.3 remains the default release. Use this candidate to evaluate the new
workflow with explicit assumptions before adopting it in consequential work.

### Highlights

- **Evidence-to-model drafts with review gates.** Bilingual causal discovery
  creates proposed nodes and edges linked to claims. Per-node baseline, unit,
  observation time, and stock retention must be supplied or remain gaps.
  Evidence confidence never becomes an effect-size estimate.
- **Explicit approval before numerical execution.** Deterministic screening
  cannot approve a model. A named human or agent reviewer must provide complete
  decisions and rationales bound to the proposal and evidence. Partial review
  exports candidates and assumptions without producing a runnable model.
- **Atomic model publication.** Apply accepts only a fresh or empty target,
  stages artifacts on the destination filesystem, and verifies the standard
  disk compiler, numerical run, and replay before publishing one directory.
  Existing models, traces, and unrelated workspace files are preserved.
- **Direct solutions for eligible linear loops.** `linear_auto` decomposes
  instantaneous strongly connected components and solves nonsingular linear
  systems with pivoting. Unsupported, singular, or nonconvergent models retain
  explicit diagnostics. No hidden delays or edge pruning alter the model.
- **Multi-round strategic roleplay.** Actor packets, committed actions, model,
  engine configuration, and scenario specification are bound together. Replay
  derives interventions again and verifies state, payoffs, round hashes, and
  finalized receipts. Engine errors cannot become published payoffs.
- **Stricter artifact validation.** Proposal/review sidecars reject malformed
  types, nonfinite values, and invalid observation timestamps. Numerical trace
  validation covers nested state, sampled parameters, integration records,
  and supported transform modes.

### Research component and provenance

The bundled D Research runtime brings explicit search failure statuses,
validated host-result artifacts, DNS-pinned public-network transport, and
opt-in CDP reuse with ownership limited to task pages and descendants.
The component lock records its exact source and distributed bytes. Local
candidate snapshots and published upstream tag provenance remain separate
policies; a local checksum cannot impersonate an upstream attestation.

### Upgrade guidance

Download `aleph-skill-runtime-v2.5.0-rc.1.zip` for normal use, or
`aleph-skill-v2.5.0-rc.1.zip` for development and validation. Verify the archives
before extraction, and install into a new directory. Preserve existing
simulation workspaces and version-bound receipts; regenerate receipts when a
workflow needs to bind the new component identity.

```sh
python "<ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT>/scripts/preflight.py" --json
python "<ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT>/scripts/research_gateway.py" research:preflight --json
python "<ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT>/scripts/auto_causal_inducer.py" --help
python "<ALEPH_SKILL_ROOT>/scripts/interactive_roleplay.py" --help
```

Read [the candidate workflow contract](../../references/upgrade-completion.md)
before using the new commands. Auto-causal output verifies a numerical model;
full final-scenario assurance still requires the normal research evidence map,
receipts, actor tracks, scenario artifacts, and final validation gates.

### Compatibility

| Component | Support |
|---|---|
| Python | 3.10 or newer; no new mandatory dependency |
| Node.js | 18 or newer for bundled research |
| Workspace schemas | 2.0.0 default, 2.1.0 opt-in |
| Formula versions | 2.0.0 and 2.1.0 remain replayable |
| Research ledgers | Existing 14/19/22/23/37-column contracts |
| Optional browser | Playwright 1.61.1; binaries installed separately |

Existing commands and adapters remain available. Invalid inputs previously
accepted by weaker checks can now fail early with explicit diagnostics. The
stock/flow, lag, and transform semantics of approved models remain bound to
replay; historical traces are never rewritten to manufacture validation.

### Validation and operating limits

Local validation covers unit/integration regressions, adversarial acceptance,
release gates, deterministic double builds, and relocated full/runtime ZIP
execution outside Git. The release pipeline additionally runs Python 3.10-3.13
on Linux, Windows, and macOS, Node.js 18/20/22 without a browser, real Chromium
through the research gateway, lint, strict typing, and coverage checks. Refer
to the linked GitHub Actions results for the final status and any platform skips.

A causal phrase is a discovery hint, not empirical causal identification.
Numerical solvability does not establish dynamic stability, calibration, or
forecast validity. Roleplay hashes detect divergence but do not authenticate a
malicious writer able to replace every artifact. Sealed actor execution and
research HMAC receipts remain host responsibilities. Simulation outputs never
become research evidence merely because replay succeeds.

Independent live host benchmarks and prospective calibration are not claimed
for this prerelease. Browser reuse and provider fixtures do not guarantee access
to every platform or a fixed RAM saving. These limits are part of the release
contract and remain relevant after automated checks pass.

### Verify your download

Download both ZIP archives, `distribution-manifest.json`, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`
into the same directory, then run:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-v2.5.0-rc.1.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.5.0-rc.1

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-runtime-v2.5.0-rc.1.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.5.0-rc.1
```

GitHub build provenance identifies the immutable tagged inputs and workflow.
The runtime ZIP also includes an individual-file manifest. These integrity
checks do not establish causal or statistical validity.

The existing **CC BY-NC 4.0** license is unchanged.
